title: Show text
summary: R: Show text. Change the greeting. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: cat joins values and writes them out. A backslash-n adds a new line.

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
cat writes the greeting and the newline escape included in it.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Unlike print, cat does not add a new line unless you ask.
